2609.24303.title: SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration
2609.24303.paper_summary: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding pretrained PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non-monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit-weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature. Across MedMCQA and MathQA, SupportCal yields lower ECE than the agreement-only baseline for nearly all evaluated target-model configurations; supplementary TweetEval Sentiment results show the same pattern on a fixed-label classification task.
2609.24303.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練通常會改善任務表現，但可能會降低信心校準，使得後訓練的語言模型（PoLMs）比其對應的預訓練語言模型（PLMs）更過於自信。由於任務特定的標記校準數據可能成本高昂或無法獲得，對應的預訓練 PLM 提供了一個自然的無標籤參考，用於事後校準。先前的協議閘 PLM 參考校準僅使用 PoLM 和其 PLM 參考一致的例子來擬合一個標量溫度，排除不一致的例子，因為直接對齊可能會使擬合的溫度過高並引起信心不足。我們重新檢視這種二元處理。一項受控的重新引入診斷揭示了一種非單調的總體效應：允許適度比例的不一致例子可以改善校準，而當單位權重的納入接近整個不一致集時，這一好處會減少。我們引入了 SupportCal，一種無標籤的事後方法，該方法在單位權重下保留一致的例子，並根據自身基礎 PLM 的相對支持和從大小相容的候選池中選擇的預訓練參考的證實，為不一致的例子分配連續權重。我們進一步描述了何時所得到的加權目標允許有限的最佳溫度。在 MedMCQA 和 MathQA 中，SupportCal 在幾乎所有評估的目標模型配置中都比僅基於一致的基線產生更低的 ECE；補充的 TweetEval 情感結果在固定標籤分類任務上顯示出相同的模式。
